results.title: Senior AI & Machine Learning Engineer
results.description: We are seeking a talented Senior AI & Machine Learning Engineer to design and deploy state-of-the-art LLM agents, LangGraph workflows, and scalable RAG pipelines using Python, FastAPI, and vector databases. Requirements: 4+ years of Python experience, proficiency with PyTorch or TensorFlow, hands-on experience with OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain/LangGraph, and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).

results.title: Full Stack Python & React Developer
results.description: SkillFlow is looking for a Full Stack Developer experienced with FastAPI, Next.js/React, TypeScript, and Supabase / PostgreSQL. You will be building responsive user interfaces, creating robust backend endpoints, and integrating LLM-powered skills verification features. Requirements: 3+ years full-stack web development, solid Python & TypeScript skills, experience with modern CSS and state management.

results.title: Data Platform & MLOps Engineer
results.description: Looking for a seasoned MLOps Engineer to maintain end-to-end data ingestion pipelines, Docker containerized services, and CI/CD pipelines for autonomous agents. Qualifications: Strong Python skills, Kubernetes, Docker, MLflow, Airflow, and experience orchestrating model evaluation pipelines.
